Emraan Hashmi Returns in Awarapan 2 Sequel After 19 Years

The sequel to the 2007 film 'Awarapan' has released a teaser, featuring Emraan Hashmi reprising his role as Shivam Pandit. The movie is set to be released after 19 years and will feature Disha Patani and Shabana Azmi in key roles.
